demos.name: MCP Discovery
demos.description: Read-only MCP discovery: finds MCP servers, probes their tool metadata, flags poisoned or changed metadata (possible rug-pull). Demo mode scans fixtures and stubs only.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 5310; npm run doctor checks it). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:5310 only; HOST_PORT changes it, and the shelf's Start button does not set HOST_PORT). Edit composeFile to this checkout's absolute path.
